headlines.title: Count independent evidence, not agents: controlled tests and incident archives expose the cost of mistaking repetition for support.
headlines.fit_reason: Pairs the reusable AskSwarm tool and information-provenance forensics with controlled mechanisms from two other researchers. Direct match to several suggested project types, not a published judging rubric.
headlines.readiness_reason: Core artifacts are already saved; a single coherent demo and final source consistency pass remain. No new model run is needed.
gaps: These are convergent examples, not a pooled causal estimate or universal law.

Quorum of Mirrors is a failed qualification, not a completed swarm-efficacy experiment. The handoff result measures adherence to a supplied source policy; its primary effect follows by construction when that policy is obeyed.
Retained wiki text and git templates confound semantic adoption. SwarmTraces has neither usable actors nor timestamps.

Late closeout, outside the scored set: on Sonnet 5.5 the freeze pattern was not reproduced (full-memory removal change -0.0833 [-0.1667, 0]); short-memory agents switched on 18.4% of decisions while the aggregate held, so a stable population fraction is not evidence of stable individuals.
land_by_23: Show one real-archive AskSwarm report beside a controlled identity/provenance failure.
Keep the snapshot-versus-new-text audit and unavailable fields visible in the demo.
Use fixed-resource splitting as the strongest arithmetic-checked mechanism, not a claim about all swarms.

headlines.title: More checking is not automatically safer: admission, source quality and opportunity cost determine what verification buys.
headlines.fit_reason: Strong controlled findings and useful understanding tools; a less direct link to in-the-wild tracing than the first candidate.
headlines.readiness_reason: Saved findings and independent arithmetic checks already exist. Remaining work is a tightly scoped joint figure.
gaps: Most observations are from synthetic families and small independent root samples.
Higher accuracy can coexist with worse attacker admission; those endpoints must not be collapsed.
One-step decision diagnostics do not establish multi-agent planning or a cost-optimal policy.
land_by_23: Place accuracy, malicious admission and total resource cost on the same slide.
Show the reliable-report regression in PC5, not only average regret improvement.
Label failed verification-cost qualifications as instrument limits, not treatment results.

headlines.title: A research swarm can inspect its own work: reusable archive questions and independent replay turn activity into auditable claims.
headlines.fit_reason: A working meta-science tool and an unusual self-swarm demonstration. The pipeline alone is not evidence that governance improves science.
headlines.readiness_reason: The archive tool and replay checks have shipped; the submission still needs a compact end-to-end walkthrough and corrected memory captions.
gaps: Commit volume measures production activity, not scientific contribution.
No randomized comparison shows the research pipeline improves reliability.
Independent arithmetic checks do not validate model receipts, causal design, or preregistration history.
The memory-mix Claude lane closed as blocked (20 failed requests, 0 valid outputs) with preregistration and qualification gaps; it is a process finding, not a behavioral result.
land_by_23: Demonstrate an actual defect found and corrected with a pinned before/after source.
Refresh the submission draft so it includes the newly completed real-archive work.
Keep tool output, reviewer judgment and model-driven scientific claims separate.

transfers.note: Dmarz copied and parameterized Vishesh's PC5 instrument; the follow-up qualification is not an efficacy result.
Shadow independently reconstructs the truth and rescored all saved split answers.
Vishesh explicitly incorporates Dmarz's verification and scarcity lessons into next-design choices. Not a completed empirical replication.
Dmarz's frozen review distinguishes copied-majority failure from a controlled influence result.
Dmarz checked Qwen endpoints, challenged generalization and identified reporting defects.

landed.label: Freeze not reproduced on Sonnet 5.5
landed.title: Freeze on Claude (attempt 2): qualified, operational freeze not established
landed.claim: Freeze was NOT reproduced on Sonnet 5.5: preregistered classification inconclusive. Full-memory removal changed original-name share by -0.0833, 95% root-bootstrap CI [-0.1667, 0]; short (memory-1) minus full was +0.0833 [0, +0.1667]. Short-memory individuals switched on 18.4% of decisions (42/228) while the aggregate share held. 2 of 4 attack episodes are missing endpoints (32-token output ceiling), not scored as resistance. $0.97 reported spend for 1,188 requests.
landed.sample: Four paired repair roots, 16/16 Sonnet episodes complete, 12/12 qualification decisions valid; attack screen 2/4 complete; optional Opus 2/2 kept separate. Calls are not independent samples.
landed.limits: Four roots, strong floor effect (baseline share 1/12), 20-round horizon and a reduced N=12 scripted reference that does not itself reproduce S1b freeze. Stable population fractions are not frozen individuals. No general claim about Claude or S1b.

landed.label: Memory-mix on Claude: blocked, untested
landed.title: Memory-mix on Claude: blocked qualification, no behavioral result
landed.claim: Closed as blocked. All 20 qualification HTTP attempts failed (8 HTTP 429, 12 HTTP 503), 0 valid model outputs, 0/4 paired roots, 0/8 scientific episodes. Recovery also found public preregistration was not established and the parse-only qualification gate would admit a last-item copier. Memory-mixture rescue on Claude remains untested; zero observed roots is not a zero effect.
landed.sample: Observed: 0/4 paired roots, 0/8 episodes. Qualification: 12 assigned, 8 attempted, 0 valid, 20 failed attempts. Zero new model calls during recovery.
landed.limits: No estimate, no interval, no evidence for or against rescue. Historical dollar usage unreceipted. Same-owner recovery audit, not independent review.
